purpose: Outcome-blind matching metadata only; never a neural-network input
fit_unit: Every canonical-chromosome ATAC narrowPeak row from each original donor source separately; retain genuine source rows without treating duplicate anchors as new fit observations
signal_field: narrowPeak field 7, the original finite signalValue
mapping: Frozen per-source mid-distribution empirical CDF: (count(training signal < x) + 0.5 * count(training signal = x)) / n_training
ties: All equal numeric signal values receive the identical midpoint of their empirical probability mass; this is not the pretraining-1.0 average-rank/n convention
between_training_values: Step mapping count(training signal < x) / n_training; no interpolation
missing_or_nonfinite_signal: Stop rather than impute or fit a different denominator
application: Apply exactly the same frozen source mapping to train, chr7 and chr8-9 rows without refitting, including the training observations themselves
anchor_aggregation: Maximum mapped percentile across all source ATAC peaks that generate the identical 1000 bp summit anchor
unanchored_intervals: Retain interval_id and leave normalized value empty, as in the original feature table; never impute accessibility
output_contract: Sidecar preserves every original interval_id and ordering. Join by interval_id. Replace only the matching covariate atac_signal_percentile_max with atac_signal_percentile_max_train_only; all other original features remain unchanged
source_of_truth: Original donor ATAC narrowPeak files, reconciled row-for-row to frozen pretraining-1.0 ATAC_peak_evidence; original files and feature table remain untouched
heldout_use: Held-out construction covariates may be mapped and audited, but are excluded from all mapping-fit counts and extrema
execution: CPU data construction only; no phase-I feature extraction, model inference or training
